text.2:213: Mankind were one community, and Allah sent (unto them) prophets as bearers of good tidings and as warners, and revealed therewith the Scripture with the truth that it might judge between mankind concerning that wherein they differed. And only those unto whom (the Scripture) was given differed concerning it, after clear proofs had come unto them, through hatred one of another. And Allah by His Will guided those who believe unto the truth of that concerning which they differed. Allah guideth whom He will unto a straight path.
text.4:165: Messengers of good cheer and of warning, in order that mankind might have no argument against Allah after the messengers. Allah was ever Mighty, Wise.
text.6:48: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Whoso believeth and doeth right, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
text.13:7: Those who disbelieve say: If only some portent were sent down upon him from his Lord! Thou art a warner only, and for every folk a guide.
text.18:56: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve contend with falsehood in order to refute the Truth thereby. And they take Our revelations and that wherewith they are threatened as a jest.
text.26:194: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
text.26:208: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
text.27:92: And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.
text.37:72: And verily We sent among them warners.
text.38:4: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
text.38:65: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,
text.44:3: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
text.46:29: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.
text.50:2: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
text.79:45: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
